message:
No, you are perfectly justified flinging poo.  Of course, that would meaning flinging Hu's poorly-thought-out article at itself.  I imagine that, at least for a brief moment, the time-space continuum would resembleda mobius strip if you do that.

I'm constantly amazed when news writers treat teachers as experts in education.  Hint: it never seems to be when asking about how we should evaluate student progress.  Reporters only actually "report" teacher opinion as fact when dealing with ancellary things like how brand-new and under-theorized and implemented projects like laptop iniatives are going.

At least they could have the decency to ask about how the new coffee pot in the teacher's lounge is affecting test scores.  Maybe they could speculate on the new automatic flagpole and its effect on NCLB.
